newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper gains, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper gains, other metals steady.

text.p: Copper prices firmed on a stromg global trend while other base metals remained steady in limited activity, dealers said.
Copper rose 50 rupees to 13,800 rupees per quintal as a rally in the world market triggered speculative buying while physical demand aided the firm trend.
Zinc was steady at 8,050 rupees per quintal (100 kg). Tin was unchanged at 30,900 rupees per quintal. Tin fell 300 rupees per quintal on Monday.
Nickel was steady at 36,300 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was unchanged at 7,700 rupees per quintal.
Bombay Metals Exchange president Sharad Parikh said copper met with speculative interest following a firm trend in the world market.
